text:
mia: small doc cleanup: found 2 broken anchors and an autoscale SDK snippet that misleads about units (shows 30, no units). opening a PR.
rahul: thanks. which field is confusing?
mia: docs shows `cooldown: 30` in the YAML example. our v2 SDKs use milliseconds. i'll change example to `cooldownMs: 30000` and add a migration box with the old examples.
clare: can we standardize on the term `isolation decorator` across the provisioning and SLA pages? some readers confuse it with network isolation.
mia: yes, i'll update wording and the TOC anchors to `#isolation-decorator` so grep/CI catches it.
patchbot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8012 labels: docs, quickfix, ci.
rahul: include a tiny smoke YAML in the PR body and a CI test step: `yarn gen:docs && grep -n "isolation-decorator" site/_build || exit 1`.
mia: added snippet and CI test step. snippet:
```
scalePolicy:
  type: autoscale
  minReplicas: 1
  maxReplicas: 4
  cooldownMs: 30000  # v2 SDK expects ms; older examples used seconds
isolation:
  decorator: tenant-prefer
```
clare: i'll review the SLA overlap wording. ping me on the PR.
mia: pinged. merging after approvals + green CI. will follow up to patch sample repos that embed the old snippet if needed.
